title: Apple job listing details agentic AI leadership for cross-app automation
summary: A Senior Engineering Manager, Agentic AI listing indicates Apple is building assistants to execute multi-step workflows across terminal commands, APIs, and web tools.
research_notes:
Configure accessibility, full-disk access, and automation security settings through the multi-step permission prompts in macOS beta environments to enable external computer-use tooling.

Align automated development scripts with standard terminal utilities, supported APIs, and application-specific scripting dictionaries rather than unfettered UI capture pending native Apple agent API releases.

Plan for expanded security authorization dialogs in upcoming macOS versions when architecting automated desktop workflows.

Structure agentic tools around explicit sandboxed API calls and CLI endpoints instead of relying on fragile synthetic user interface events.
